name: Malfunctioning Teleportation Circle (CR 13)
body:
Malfunctioning Teleportation Circle
CR 13

XP 25,600

Type magic; Perception DC 34; Disable Device DC 34

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset automatic

Effect arcane feedback (18d6 damage, DC 23 Reflex save for half damage); multiple targets (all targets in 5-foot-radius burst inside circle)
